[RDSC.4.7] **`module_id` — per-module join key.** Every
per-module atom carries a compiler-assigned `module_id` (a u32
starting at 1; `module_id = 0` is the reserved "unset"
sentinel and must not appear in an emitted atom) that
identifies the source module the atom belongs to. The
compiler assigns `module_id` in import-DAG topological order
(leaves first, importer last). The runtime joins `DsSource` /
`LineSpan` / `SchemaSource` / `RuleSource` / `SchemaTtl` / `SchemaLogical` / `Slot` / `Hydration`
/ `SchemaDef` / `RuleCooldown` / `DocString` / `TestCase` atoms across the
bundle by `module_id`; `AlphaNode` / `BetaNode` / `TerminalNode` atoms are
joined by `node_id` (globally unique per bundle) rather than
`module_id`. Tooling that needs the display path for a
`module_id` resolves via `DsSource[module_id].file`. No
per-module atom carries a display-path string of its own;
the runtime fills the equivalent display strings on its
public-API view structs from `DsSource` at apply time.
